# CLIPTORA n8n fork

This directory contains a modified copy of n8n `2.45.0`.

- Upstream repository: <https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n>
- Upstream tag: `n8n@2.45.0`
- Upstream commit: `7c79fd09a04e256a6b14bf29a40355a73a17d79d`
- Imported into CLIPTORA: 2026-10-26

CLIPTORA modifies the editor title, favicon, logo, and brand color. CLIPTORA also packages its
private video-tool node with the built runtime. The workflow editor, node system, credential store,
execution engine, and official integrations remain the genuine n8n implementation.

The upstream `LICENSE.md`, `LICENSE_EE.md`, copyright notices, and third-party notices are retained.
Files with `.ee.` in their name or `.ee` in their directory remain subject to the n8n Enterprise
License. This fork does not grant access to Enterprise features.

Do not redistribute this fork, provide it as a hosted service, or make it available to external
customers without checking the n8n license and obtaining any required commercial agreement.
